name: Checkout completion race
description: Two entry points complete the same checkout session; order creation is not idempotent and the payment hold is released before confirmation, so a second confirm can fail with PAYMENT_NOT_LOCKED or duplicate the order.

observations.title: Order creation is not idempotent for a session
observations.detail: {file} has no uniqueness guard on the session id. Every completion that reaches orders.create() books a brand-new order, so a second (legitimate) completion duplicates it.

observations.title: Payment hold released before idempotency is guaranteed
observations.detail: completeCheckout() creates the order at line {line_a} and immediately releases the hold at line {line_b}. After release, any second completion observes PAYMENT_NOT_LOCKED even though the payment succeeded - the customer sees an intermittent checkout failure.

remediation.reason: Make order creation idempotent per session (return the existing order for late/duplicate confirmations) and keep the payment hold until confirmation.

coverage_gap.title: Missing regression coverage for concurrent checkout completion
coverage_gap.detail: No test exercises the webhook and API confirmations racing for the same session. The happy path alone cannot catch a duplicate-order / PAYMENT_NOT_LOCKED defect.
